text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"repeated formal openings like \"Hello Mr. Manager\" and \"would like to vist your work space\"","quality":"tone control","description":"It sustains a more appropriate, audience-aware register for a persuasive letter rather than sounding conversational or vague."},{"evidence":"paragraphs that build from \"learn about how you work\" to \"understand what kind of company this is\"","quality":"organization","description":"It develops ideas in a clearer progression, with each paragraph extending the same line of reasoning."},{"evidence":"phrases like \"help narrow the options a bit\" and \"will help me pick what college I want\"","quality":"idea development","description":"It gives more specific support and consequences for the main point instead of staying at a very general level."},{"evidence":"\"what your goal is for the future\" and \"what course to take\"","quality":"clarity of expression","description":"It communicates its message more directly and with fewer confusing or broken phrasings."},{"evidence":"fewer sentence fragments such as \"This visit will help me understand how the people are too\"","quality":"sentence control","description":"It shows somewhat better control over complete sentence structure even though errors remain."}]}
